item_short_desc: Rothco's Brown Leather Medic Bag is made with a premium rugged leather that is both durable and stylish. The leather medic bag features a large main compartment w/interior zippered pocket, front flap w/leather strap closures, 1½" wide adjustable leather shoulder strap, antique brass hardware, 12½" x 11" x 3½"
